narratives.body: RB Leipzig coach Martín Demichelis praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Champions League clash against Real Madrid at the Bernabéu.
narratives.headline: Demichelis praises Yan Diomande ahead of Real Madrid clash

narratives.body: Demichelis stated that Franco Mastantuono needs time to develop but believes he is built for Real Madrid despite his loan spell at Fiorentina.
narratives.headline: Demichelis insists Franco Mastantuono is built for Real Madrid
